This '''pin-up''' of a [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] was a decorative [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It showed a scantily clad Felucian in a seductive pose.<ref name="Deception" />

==Behind the scenes==
This poster was painted by [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] concept artist [[Randy Bantog]].<ref name="SW-Deception Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deception-trivia-gallery|text="Deception" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref>
